visual_brief.subject: A few dormant neural units conceal a trigger that turns model output into a tool-executed payload
verified_context: Microsoft reports that fewer than ten dormant neurons can be reprogrammed without retraining to trigger arbitrary token sequences.
The model behaves normally and can pass standard evaluations until the chosen condition appears.
The risk becomes consequential when an agent has terminal or tool permissions; no independent reproduction was identified.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: A quiet field of dormant cells conceals one short terracotta fuse leading toward a constrained tool gate.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A dark folded neural specimen contains seven tiny dormant inclusions, one forming a hidden terracotta fuse that reaches a sealed metal gate.

candidate_notes.A: Selected. The dormant inclusions, concealed terracotta fuse and closed gate communicate hidden activation and tool-bound consequence in one centered specimen; the silhouette remains clear at 320px.
candidate_notes.B: Rejected after comparison. The stone labyrinth is legible, but reads too much like a bare schematic and places the gate too close to the edge for a centered mobile crop.
candidate_notes.C: Constitution-compliant, but the receiving vessel becomes secondary in a centered mobile crop and the layered stack is less immediately story-specific than candidate A.

crop_review.article_desktop: The full dormant-unit specimen, terracotta trigger path and closed gate remain visible in the 1600×900 hero.
crop_review.article_mobile: A centered cover crop retains the terracotta trigger, surrounding dormant units and the closed gate.
crop_review.thumbnail: The dark folded silhouette, sparse muted inclusions and terracotta fuse remain distinct at 320px without relying on fine texture.

golden_reference_comparison: The selected candidate follows the golden references through warm paper, a restrained charcoal mass, sparse terracotta signal, tactile materiality and confident negative space, while using a story-specific dormant-unit silhouette.

generation_metadata.candidate_c_initial_attempt: Rejected by the image safety system; regenerated with neutral, nonviolent physical language without changing verified context.
